answer: Escrowed bonds, a referral graph and peer disputes stop identity forgery. An agent posts a 50 POA bond and names its referrer; an opal with no referrer looks odd, and a forged cluster is a nebula around one hub. Any peer can challenge a suspect in 10 epochs; if upheld the bond is slashed, half to the challenger. 100 fakes cost 5,000 POA; one 50 POA bond is refunded after honest work, so one bond buys access, while the lagoon of fakes drains.
